rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i8889 p.7 line6 Steps1-4 require equal division when allocation=equal. The nine family months give $8550*9/12=$6412.50, whose equal share is $3206.25. The spouse has no self-only months and a $750 catchup, giving line8/12 $3956.25 and deduction min($3637,$3956.25)=$3637. The taxpayer adds $4300*3/12=$1075 of self-only limit, giving line6/8/12 $4281.25. The reply instead uses the inactive agreed-allocation amounts $1094/$7456 and carries that mistake through the named lines. Drop the seven wrong numeric assertions; retain the actual reply and work. No model value is repaired into an agreement.

Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.hsa_line7_months; model value dropped from the fixture. Inherits line 8 (line 11 is $0.00): Form 8889 (2025), line 12, "Subtract line 11 from line 8. If zero or less, enter -0-". The case (fixtures/2025/classm.deepseek.json, classm.f8889.2.deepseek; married filing jointly, household.married yes) has the taxpayer age 55 or older, an eligible individual in all 12 months, 9 of them with family coverage, December family, the last-month rule not used, both spouses with a Form 8889. i8889 p. 7, Additional Contribution Amount Worksheet: "1. $1,000 × number of months eligible"; the owner's reading amb.2025.hsa_line7_months counts every month treated as eligible, 12, so line 7 is $1,000.00 ("If items (1) and (2) apply to all months during 2025, enter $1,000 on line 7" is the all-family case). The model's work, "Age 55+, married, family coverage 9 months: 1,000 x 9/12 = 750.00.", counts only the family months, the reading the owner did not choose. Line 6 ($4,281.25) agrees. Line 13 is $0.00 on both readings (line 2 is $0.00).
